entries.text: Added a runner for the shipped TPC-DI DIGen tool: it needs Java 8, prints the licence notice on every generation, obeys the run time limit, and records a SHA-256 manifest of every generated file. TPC-DI stays unavailable from the command line.
details: DIGen scale factors are whole numbers of 3 or more; any other value is refused before Java starts.
BENCHBOX_TPCDI_JAVA_OPTS sets the JVM options DIGen passes to its generation process.
